components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action with the user's selected accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-brand-700); color: #f6f6f6; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border-strong); border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 0 var(--color-brand-700); font-family: 'Kode Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-800); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 var(--color-brand-700); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action that stays visible on dark surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #f6f6f6; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-on-surface-muted); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Kode Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-on-surface); background: rgb(209 209 209 / 0.1); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 0 var(--color-brand-700); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-secondary { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: AniDev debe sentirse cómodo, libre, versátil y bajo control de la persona. La interfaz acompaña el descubrimiento con jerarquía editorial y un acento personalizable.
keyCharacteristics: Base oscura con capas tonales cercanas.

rules.name: The Personal Accent Rule
rules.body: El acento puede ser expresivo, pero el texto del botón primario debe mantener un contraste mínimo de 4.5:1 con su fondo. Restringe los acentos seleccionables a valores compatibles con el foreground elegido o selecciona dinámicamente un foreground conforme; nunca renderices una combinación que incumpla el contraste.

dos: Do preserve the user's accent-color choice across interactive states.
Do use semantic HTML, visible focus, and readable contrast.
Do keep discovery flexible through responsive layouts and clear hierarchy.
donts: Don't make the catalog feel like a rigid administrative table.
Don't use decoration that competes with titles, artwork, or metadata.
Don't assume one fixed accent color when the product supports customization.
